## Background

The scheduled failure notification added in #6503 should use the `public` GitHub environment to resolve its Slack webhook.

## What changed

Set `notify-nightly-failure.environment` to `public` in `.github/workflows/cicd-main.yml`.

## Tested

- `gh secret list --repo NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge --env public`: confirmed `SLACK_WEBHOOK` is defined. Environment metadata reports no protection rules or deployment branch restrictions.
- `uv run --no-project --with pre-commit pre-commit run --all-files`: all applicable hooks passed.
- Parsed YAML comparison against `origin/main`: the notification job's environment is the only configuration change.
- Actionlint comparison against `origin/main`: identical existing diagnostics; no new findings.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

These checks validate configuration; live Slack delivery remains unverified.
